findings: law-categories.ts uses explicit slug, ministry, and title-keyword rules to assign each law one or more categories.
export-laws.ts derives a primary category from the multi-category set and writes category-wise JSON under data/laws/.
ingest-laws.ts stores both the full category set and the derived primary category when ingesting law metadata.
data/laws/_index.json summarizes 846 laws and 35685 sections across the related app category buckets.
adoptedHere: explicit slug overrides for important laws
one primary category for list grouping
secondary category tags for reviewable multi-taxonomy matches
notAdoptedHere: duplicating one law into multiple main category groups
using related-app data as legal text source of truth
